name: tamiltvserial.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But buttons must have discernible text.
lesson: Give every button text or an aria-label, so a screen reader can announce it.
summary: www.tamiltvserial.com scores 81 out of 100 (B). 1 check fails now, 21 are at risk, and 38 pass. Fix first: buttons must have discernible text.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /, /category/sun-tv/, /category/vijay-tv/, for example .search-submit. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: 30 images are not served as WebP or AVIF
fix.evidence: Siragadikka-Aasai-17.jpg on / (JPEG, 94 KB), Siragadikka-Aasai-15.jpg on /category/vijay-tv/ (JPEG, 93 KB), Thaai-Maaman-8.jpg on / (JPEG, 92 KB), Onna-Irukka-Kaththukanum-7.jpg on / (JPEG, 88 KB) and 26 more. WebP is about 30% smaller at the same quality,…
fix.fix: Serve WebP or AVIF through the CDN or image service, or with <picture> and a JPEG or PNG fallback.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Analytics (2 requests), and cookies _ga_5CY5PSFX5R, _ga, ID on my.rtmark.net.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: 10 structured data items miss a property Google expects
fix.evidence: /poongodi-26-10-2026-episode-520-sun-tv-serial/ Article lacks author, /ethir-neechal-26-10-2026-episode-660-sun-tv-serial/ Article lacks author, /malli-26-10-2026-episode-900-sun-tv-serial/ Article lacks author and 7 more.
fix.fix: Fill the missing properties so the item qualifies for rich results.

fix.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: A window the page opens, or that opens it, keeps a handle to it, which tabnabbing and cross-site leaks use. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin-allow-popups, or same-origin when the site opens no sign-in or payment popup.
